incident_name: US East 1 - Multiple services (Partial Service Disruption)
incident_description:
From 13 March 2026 21:21 UTC to 13 March 2026 22:11 UTC, customers using Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and dependent services in AWS us-east-1 experienced service disruptions. All services are now restored

Symptoms

Customers experienced:
- Unity Catalog operations failing, including data access and permission checks
- Databricks SQL queries failing or not completing
- Mosaic AI Vector Search requests failing
- System Tables (Lineage) requests failing

Current Status

This incident has been fully resolved as of 13 March 2026 22:11 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Next Update

No further updates are planned unless conditions change.
